name: Plage de Sfiha
hero_subtitle: Large plage familiale à l’est de la ville avec vue vers le Peñón de Alhucemas.

overview.title: Family sand and Peñón views
overview.p1: Sfiha is a wider family beach east of the centre, with more space than Quemado and views toward the Peñón de Alhucemas on clear days.
overview.p2: Seasonal cafés and basic beach services appear in summer. A short taxi from town is the usual access.
overview.p3: Many families prefer the extra room; both Sfiha and Quemado are urban-style Mediterranean beaches.

q1.question: How do I get to Sfiha?
q1.answer: Short taxi from the centre; confirm the fare before you ride.

q2.question: Better than Quemado for kids?
q2.answer: Many families prefer the extra space; both are urban-style beaches.

q3.question: Can I see the Peñón?
q3.answer: Yes, on clear days the islet is part of the seaward view.

q4.question: Facilities?
q4.answer: Seasonal cafés and basic beach services are usual in summer.

q5.question: Swimming conditions?
q5.answer: Generally good in summer; always check local sea conditions.
